Hi all,

Thanks again for agreeing to a focused technical deep-dive between your architects and our solutions team. The primary goal is to walk the Finovate integration path (auth, streaming fallback, and KV cache warmup) and validate performance at expected peak windows.

Given the team spread (US east, EU central, Japan), we want to propose a small set of overlap windows that respect local working hours and DST quirks. Please indicate preferred slot(s) or exceptions. I attached a short agenda and a rough timezone table as a starting point.

Proposed slots (all times in UTC with local conversions below):
- Option A: 13:00 - 14:30 UTC (US ET 09:00-10:30, CET 15:00-16:30, JST 22:00-23:30)
- Option B: 15:00 - 16:30 UTC (US ET 11:00-12:30, CET 17:00-18:30, JST 00:00-01:30 next day)
- Option C: 07:30 - 09:00 UTC (US ET 03:30-05:00, CET 09:30-11:00, JST 16:30-18:00)

Notes: CET will move with DST later in the year — this is why we're sticking to UTC anchors. Japan has no DST changes; please call out any local holidays that may block your team.

Attachments: agenda_redwood-deep-dive_v1.docx, timezone_overlap_table_UTC_conversions.csv

Quick asks:
- Reply with 1-2 preferred options (A/B/C) and names of the engineers who will attend.
- Call out any date constraints around local holidays (so we don't accidentally pick a bank holiday).
